Page 75 Cont.
June Jean Slater - 15 - heart trouble and dropsey ..... Also her sister Marilyn Bassett- 13 - louse hair is falling out .....
Rita Whitwell - 19 - Thyroid-gland ... . weighs 218 .. ..
John Felmer - 54 - of Ferndale - bad case of Ferndaly: - continual fever.
Couple want work - Mrs .- Mr. Vallet - young middle aged - looking for w. 4468 - 16th
Mrs. Mary Healey - 84 - of Sheboygan - here for 3rd time To-day - What threateded to be cancer seems to be drying up. ... Enrolled 3rd time.
Page 76 June 16 Thanks. . . Russell, James - 48 - presbiterian - very peculiar lame leg and foot - could sleep very little from continual pain for three years. Dr's in Grace Hospital sent him home as one hopeless case ..... June 2nd A Catholic neighbor, Mrs. Eby, enrolled him June 2nd (3) in Ser. Masses ... Two weeks To-night. Just a week lat- er he walked and is here Tonight with wife and Cath. friend ..... Enrolls perpetually - O.K. Mr. Russell's ancesters .. line away back presbiterian Ministers.
17 Mrs. Hattie Taylor - 58 - Moore Town, Ont. Ca. - badly fallen arches Drs can do nothing for her. Enrolled Today ... promising
Mrs. Sara Maurer - 45 - goitre operation - figured dan. near fat. Casimir Kaciemba - 27 - stroke - bad heart, unable to speak
Joseph Whitham - Episcopelian - 39 - two broken ankles - three major operations. One andle Okay; the other turned to ostemolitis and they fear necessity of removal - 18 months not able to work.
Page 77 June Wm. Tuhonen - 34 - drinking-trying to get divorce .... has not been practicing his faith lately .... Except going to church.
Julia Kujawa - 71 - of Royal Oak - deaf in one ear since birth; was totally deaf at 17 -(54 yrs. ago) - restored to perfect hearing at that time by coming hither for bl. twice a week for a whole year. In accident July 1932 and had her ear -drum broken. Can still hear a little with instrument.
